correctness.rationale: PASS: All triple products vanish, so the Zinbiel identity and class-two universal property are immediate. For S≤A, W=π_V S, Z=S∩T and lift map f:W→T/Z are unique. Multiplying lifts produces exactly w⊗w′, hence subalgebra iff W⊗W⊆Z and ideal iff W⊗V+V⊗W⊆Z. A complement V=W⊕U splits T and gives dim r² and 2nr−r²; choosing W, required-containing Z and a freely varying Hom(W,T/Z) gives N_sub=[n r]_q[n²−r² z−r²]_q q^{r(n²−z)} and N_ideal=[n r]_q[(n−r)² z−(2nr−r²)]_q q^{r(n²−z)}. Complement of W⊗W in Z proves abstract A_r⊕zero^{z−r²}; dim S²=r² distinguishes types. Independent Gaussian counts for n=2: over F2 polynomial coefficients sub [1,15,59,99,43,3,1] total221 and ideals [1,15,35,15,7,3,1] total77; over F3 totals 949 and229.
